name: Readora
description: An event-driven platform of 10 Spring Boot microservices behind Spring Cloud Gateway, with an MCP server that exposes catalog, cart, and order data to a RAG reading assistant — plus a full GitOps pipeline to a Kubernetes cluster.
bullets: Architected 10 Spring Boot microservices behind Spring Cloud Gateway with JWT auth and Redis-backed rate limiting; coordinated 10 Kafka topics via the transactional outbox pattern with idempotent consumers and circuit breakers.
Built an MCP server exposing catalog, cart, and order data as tool-callable endpoints for a RAG reading assistant (Azure OpenAI + pgvector semantic search).
Shipped 3 React + TypeScript apps with Redux Toolkit and STOMP/SockJS for real-time order and notification updates.
Delivered a GitOps pipeline of 13 GitHub Actions workflows enforcing a 90% JaCoCo coverage gate, with ArgoCD auto-syncing an AKS cluster and OpenTelemetry tracing to New Relic.

name: Synapse AI
description: An enterprise-grade distributed microservices platform that turns unstructured data into structured insight — Retrieval-Augmented Generation, real-time collaboration, event-driven architecture, and Azure cloud-native services under one roof.
bullets: Designed a distributed microservice architecture with deep RAG integration for turning unstructured documents into searchable, structured knowledge.
Implemented real-time collaboration and pub-sub, event-driven communication patterns across services, including Change Data Capture (CDC).
Built a security architecture with full logging and observability across the platform, deployed on Azure cloud-native infrastructure.

name: Global Connect
description: A cloud-native recruitment ecosystem unifying the hiring experience for candidates, recruiters, companies, and admins — with multi-dimensional ATS scoring and a transparent, structured feedback loop instead of keyword matching.
bullets: Built multi-dimensional ATS scoring (skills + experience + education + projects + feedback) to replace naive keyword matching.
Designed a 'Connects' feature enabling structured, transparent candidate-manager feedback visible to recruiters.
Unified candidates, recruiters, companies, and admins into a single microservices-backed ecosystem instead of siloed portals.

name: Enterprise Learning System
description: Built for the Microsoft Foundry "Reasoning Agents" Hackathon — turns a static course catalog into a personalized learning surface, orchestrated across five specialist AI agents.
bullets: A Foundry orchestrator agent routes each request to one of five specialist agents (curator, assessment, planner, engagement, manager-insights) over the A2A protocol.
Grounded agent responses in MongoDB via MCP and in certification material through a Foundry IQ knowledge base.
Shipped a learner dashboard with personalized recommendations driven entirely by the multi-agent pipeline.

name: Ocean Explorer Probe
description: A remotely controlled submersible probe API built for the NatWest Ocean Explorer Kata — a clean-code showcase built around SOLID principles, the Command and Strategy patterns, and a 103-test suite.
bullets: Applied the Command pattern to encapsulate each control instruction, enabling queueing, replay, and decoupled execution from parsing.
Abstracted movement calculation behind a Strategy interface so new movement behaviours can be added without touching existing code.
Backed the domain with 103 tests across 8 classes, covering boundaries, obstacle handling, and 10 end-to-end integration scenarios.

name: Competitive Programming
description: A growing archive of Codeforces and DSA solutions in C++, organized by pattern — Binary Search, Bit Manipulation, Greedy, and Math & Number Theory — built while solving 500+ problems across LeetCode, Codeforces, and GeeksforGeeks.
bullets: Solutions organized by algorithmic pattern rather than by problem source, for quick interview-prep review.
Covers Binary Search, Bit Manipulation, Greedy Algorithms, Graphs, DP, and Math & Number Theory.

name: Hiccup
description: A real-time, peer-to-peer video conferencing app built with WebRTC for direct audio/video and Socket.io for signaling — low-latency calls with minimal setup.
bullets: Implemented direct peer-to-peer video/audio streaming with WebRTC.
Built the signaling layer and connection management with Socket.io.
